item.title: Friendship Day Magic & Surprise
item.description:
Friendship Day Magic & Surprise

Send your best friend an unforgettable interactive Friendship Day website! Packed with mini-games, secret custom wish reveals, and instant WhatsApp sharing.

Specifications & Features

  • Interactive Heart Collector Game: Catch falling friendship hearts before time runs out.
  • Scratch Card Secret Message: Reveal a hidden heartfelt or hilarious message.
  • Friendship Meter Calculator: Dynamic percentage test for your bond.
  • Confetti & Celebration: Burst of celebratory effects on page load.
  • Customizable Sender & Recipient: Add your names, custom note, and memories.
